title: Compatibility after top restriction source comparison
statement:
theorem standardSingleBaseChange_topRestriction_compatibility
    {Y B A : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ B) (M : Y.Modules) (g : A ⟶ B) :
    letI := fun X : Scheme.{u} ↦ HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    ∀ (e : (schemeDerivedDirectImage p).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M) ≅
        (schemeDerivedDirectImage ((⊤ : Y.Opens).ι ≫ p)).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (M.restrict (⊤ : Y.Opens).ι))),
      e = standardSingleBaseChange_topRestriction_sourceIso p M → ∃ (t : (schemeDerivedDirectImage
          (pullback.snd ((⊤ : Y.Opens).ι ≫ p) g)).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
            (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObj
              (pullback.fst ((⊤ : Y.Opens).ι ≫ p) g)
              (M.restrict (⊤ : Y.Opens).ι))) ≅
        (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd p g)).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
            (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObj (pullback.fst p g) M))),
      standardSingleBaseChangeMap p M g =
        (derivedPullback g).map e.hom ≫
          standardSingleBaseChangeMap ((⊤ : Y.Opens).ι ≫ p)
            (M.restrict (⊤ : Y.Opens).ι) g ≫ t.hom

proof.text: Substitute the canonical source comparison. Construct the apex isomorphism k by pullback lifts, using Y.topIso and its inverse. Verify both inverse and projection identities by pullback extensionality.

Construct the coefficient isomorphism b from tensor pullback composition, transport along the first projection identity and the tensor-to-restriction adjunction comparison. The single map along k is invertible. Compose it with single.mapIso b to define d.

Construct F from direct image of the invertible k-unit, the pinned direct-image composition, transport along the second projection identity, and direct image of d. Apply the general source-restriction unit mate identity, then postcompose with direct image of d. Coefficient coherence simplifies the inner coefficient map. Naturality of the base-change mate in the source coefficient identifies the result with pullback of the canonical source isomorphism followed by the restricted standard base-change map. Thus beta followed by F.hom is that composite. Cancel F using its inverse and return F.symm.

statement_change.old_statement: Given the source comparison isomorphism e for the top restriction, there exists a target isomorphism t such that the standard single base-change map factors through e and the restricted comparison.
statement_change.what: The universal quantification over arbitrary source isomorphisms is false. The compatibility is required only when e is the constructed canonical source comparison, expressed by an implication.
